details: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit 8a24cd2f. The release decodes TK-350 channels across all UHF bands instead of hiding them, handles the TK-359 uniform Z-plus-fill block and uses the KPG-32D 32-byte channel records with flag-byte frequencies, and bounds IC-E90 table lookups so one out-of-table channel value cannot stop the channel list. Verification: flutter analyze passed; all 254 Flutter tests passed with the bundled Python 3.13 runtime; 677 bundled Python tests passed with two fixture-dependent skips; the Ubuntu 20.04 ABI check passed with maximum GLIBC 2.18; DEB, RPM, and Pacman metadata and embedded version 1.0.77 were verified; DEB and AppImage Xvfb smoke tests passed; the AppImage launched under host Wayland and X11; package payloads include the TK-350, TK-359, and IC-E90 decoder changes and omit GLVND/EGL/GLES loaders; all public downloads returned HTTP 200; and the Linux platform manifest reports 1.0.77.
